quotation.disclaimer: Bank of China states the board is for reference only and that the rate actually executed through its online, mobile, smart-counter or branch channel governs.

parity.note: Daily RMB central parity published via CFETS. It is a fixing, not a customer or interbank tradable rate.

derived.note: All derived values are recomputed from the two published boards by build.py and again independently by verify.py. One-way figure = (sell - mid) / mid, i.e. the half-spread a customer pays on a CNY-to-USD conversion when the bank's own bid and offer bracket the mid.

boc.counter_conversion_note: Item 210107011 states that conversion at BOC's own branches carries no separate fee: the exchange rate is the price.

receiving_bank.name: Bank of America
receiving_bank.note: Bank of America states other fees or amounts may also apply, including those charged by the sending institution and foreign taxes.

quota.scope: Settlement by any individual and FX purchase by a domestic individual.
